strings.permission.title: Link Creation Permission Warning
strings.permission.symbolic_unprivileged:
mkLINK is not running as Administrator.

Even if the destination is writable, Windows symbolic link creation may be restricted by permissions or system policy.

It is recommended to restart mkLINK with Run as Administrator before creating symbolic links.

Try to create the symbolic link with the current permissions?
strings.permission.symbolic_write_fail_extra:
The destination is also not writable:
%s
strings.permission.write_fail_unprivileged:
The current permissions cannot write to the destination folder.

All three link methods need permission to create an item in the destination; this location may require administrator rights or adjusted NTFS/share permissions.

Restart mkLINK with Run as Administrator or check the destination permissions.

Detected result:
%s

Try to create with the current permissions?
strings.permission.write_fail_elevated:
mkLINK is already running as Administrator, but the destination is still not writable.

This may be caused by NTFS permissions, share permissions, read-only media, or another write restriction.

The link may fail; check destination access first.

Detected result:
%s

Try to create anyway?
